headline: Eastern Front Reignites as Heavy Fighting Spreads Across Strategic Sectors
war_summary: Since the previous edition, frontline instability has surged back across the eastern theater, breaking the temporary pause in base turnovers. Godcrofts witnessed the heaviest upheaval with nine base transitions in the last two hours, bringing all nine strategic positions under Colonial control. Stlican Shelf likewise reignited with eight fresh turnovers across Breaker Town and The Pale House. In Weathered Expanse, active base exchanges resumed alongside an explosive surge in bloodshed, claiming over thirty-two hundred combined casualties in two hours. Severe attrition continues along the central spine, where Callahan's Passage and Linn of Mercy logged two base events apiece and thousands of casualties, leaving contested positions neutralized in both sectors. Out west, Fisherman's Row remains locked in heavy combat with three further base turnovers and more than fifteen hundred casualties. In contrast, base transfers in Stonecradle have stalled over the past two hours despite persistent fighting, while the quiet rear hexes remain undisturbed.
